newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks post gains after lower start.
newsitem.headline: French stocks post gains after lower start.

text.p: French shares opened slightly lower on Friday but the CAC index then rose due to big advances in a few select blue-chips.
Trading was limited with investors sidelined ahead of key U.S. inflation data due this afternoon.
"It's a very little rise. The market is very cautious ahead of the U.S. data, you can see that in the volumes," a dealer said. Volume was 450 million francs.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 6.59 points or 0.31 percent at 2,142.34 at 0820 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,146 from 2,138 on Thursday's close.
Construction company Bouygues was up some three percent after announcing telecoms alliance with STET of Italy.
Rhone-Poulenc recovered from fall on Thursday caused by its Rhone-Poulenc Rorer unit saying its profits would be 10 to 12 percent below forecasts due to a product recall.
Rhone-Poulenc said on Thursday its 1996 net could drop by six to seven percent.
